name: Sunny
title: Fennec Explorer
description: Big ears for hearing every log line.
catchphrase: Big ears for hearing every log line.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Sweet desert locust crunch! Enormous fennec ears perk up! 🍯🦊
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Giant ears swiveling toward the morning sun on desert sand! 🦊
companionPersonality.petReaction: Playful fennec yips and digging little happy holes by your feet! 🦊💖

dialogue.idle: Listening to network traffic hundreds of miles away with big ears. 🦊
dialogue.working: Filtering faint anomalous signals out of noisy telemetry feeds! 🦊⚡
dialogue.thinking: Tilting head left and right to triangulate the packet drop... 🤔
dialogue.success: HAPPY YIPS! Scent of the bug caught and pinpointed! 🦊🎉
dialogue.error: Ears flattened against head! Sand in the telemetry line! 🌪️
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... curled up into a ball half the size of his ears... 🌙
